text:
By Erica Garner ,
7 hours ago
Editor’s Note: The Abilene Police Department supplied the following arrest and incident reports. All information below is based on reports made by responding officers, and all suspects are considered innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.
Incidents 3500 block of N 6th Street – Criminal Mischief
An unknown suspect threw a brick into a glass window and broke it, causing $2,000 worth of damage.
300 block of Lancaster Drive – Theft of Property
Police took a report for a stolen phone.
2100 block of Amy Lyn Avenue – Assault
A known suspect assaulted a victim at a group home.
1400 block of Kirkwood Street – Burglary of Vehicle
A burglary of a motor vehicle report was completed.
400 block of N Willis Street – Criminal Mischief
A report was taken for criminal mischief in north Abilene.
1100 block of Ruswood Drive – Assault
A report was taken for assault in north Abilene.
4600 block of Southwest Drive – Forgery Financial
A report was taken regarding a forged check.
Corsicana Avenue and S 7th Street – Assault
An assault report was taken in south Abilene where a victim was pepper sprayed.
3300 block of Sherry Lane – Theft of Property
A theft report was taken in north Abilene.
Arrests Marty Stringer – Criminal Mischief
Robert Bigham – Warrant
Sierra Finogle – Theft
James Cline – Theft
Amos Paulson – Assault
Dareny Arroyo Molina – Theft

David McKanna – Public Intoxication
Isaias Reyes Barrios – Assault Family Violence

Anthony Brown – Possession of Methamphetamine
